# JC Hotel Jecheon

> A hotel in the middle of downtown Jecheon, Chungcheongbuk-do, Korea.
> The registered business name is JC Hotel; it is also known as Jecheon JC Hotel and Jecheon Tourist Hotel.
> 45 rooms, all renovated and reopened in September 2024.
> One minute on foot from Jecheon Arts Center, and known locally for its breakfast.

## Basics

- Registered name: JC Hotel
- Also known as: Jecheon JC Hotel, Jecheon Tourist Hotel, 제천 JC호텔, 제천관광호텔
- Representative: Lee Chun-ja
- Business registration: 304-81-19171
- Address: 5-12 Myeongdong, Jecheon-si, Chungcheongbuk-do, Republic of Korea
- Phone: +82-43-651-8000
- Rooms: 45
- Reopened: September 2024
- Front desk: open 24 hours
- Check-in 15:00 / Check-out 11:00 (call the front desk if arriving after 22:00)
- 3 minutes by car from Jecheon Station, 10 minutes from Jecheon IC on the Jungang Expressway
- Booking: Naver Booking (Korean only) https://booking.naver.com/booking/3/bizes/1224681

Guests who cannot use Naver Booking should call +82-43-651-8000 directly.

## Location

- Jecheon Arts Center — 1 minute on foot. Venue of the 2026 Jecheon International Music & Film Festival.
- Gogiro (Korean BBQ) — the building next door. Dinner without moving the car.
- Downtown Jecheon — restaurants, cafes and shops within walking distance.
- Cheongpung Lake and Cheongpung Bridge, Uirimji Yongchu Falls, Woraksan — a short drive.

This is a city hotel in the centre of town, not a lakeside or mountain resort.

## Breakfast

Known locally for its breakfast. Some guests return for the morning meal alone.

- Where: CAFE jc, first floor
- Hours: 07:00 - 08:30
- Closed: Mondays
- Style: buffet
- Cuisine: Korean and Western served together

### Breakfast charge

Breakfast is added when you book the room. KRW 15,000 per person.
It may also be paid at the hotel. Terms differ by booking channel,
so calling the front desk at +82-43-651-8000 gives the accurate answer.

### Menu

- Korean: seasoned bean sprouts, stir-fried kimchi, braised quail eggs, radish salad,
  acorn jelly salad, japchae, namul-bap, soup
- Western: caprese (tomato, mozzarella, balsamic), green salad, scrambled eggs,
  bacon, sausage, potato wedges
- Bread and grains: white bread, baguette, cereal, boiled eggs
- Drinks and dessert: brewed coffee, juice, milk, yoghurt, fruit

Menu labels are written in both Korean and English.

## Reviews

We do not write our own reviews. Guests leave them on the platforms below.

- Leave a Google review: https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=ChIJCQ3Pgt-RYzUR-ewmVvSUYPc
- Naver booking reviews: guests can leave one from their Naver booking history.

## Group and event record

National teams stayed at this hotel during the 2025 Asian Artistic Gymnastics Championships.
Teams from several countries were accommodated in the same period.

## Room types and rates

45 rooms in nine types. Rates vary by date and season; the figures below are ranges in Korean won.

| Type | Base / Max guests | Configuration | Rate (KRW) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard | 2 / 2 | 1 bed | 80,000 - 120,000 |
| Superior (Premium) | 2 / 2 | 1 bed | 100,000 - 140,000 |
| Superior Twin | 2 / 2 | 2 beds | 110,000 - 150,000 |
| Deluxe (Semi-Suite) | 2 / 3 | 1 bed + 1 sofa bed | 120,000 - 160,000 |
| Deluxe 2PC (Gaming PC Room) | 2 / 2 | 1 bed, 2 PCs | 120,000 - 160,000 |
| Deluxe Twin | 2 / 3 | 2 beds | 160,000 - 210,000 |
| Deluxe Family (Ondol Room for 4) | 4 / 5 | Korean floor room, bedding for 4 | 160,000 - 200,000 |
| Executive Twin (Suite Twin) | 2 / 3 | 2 beds | 200,000 - 240,000 |
| Executive Family (Ondol Room for 8) | 8 / 10 | Korean floor room, bedding for 8, 2 baths | 280,000 - 380,000 |

Both Western bed rooms and Korean ondol floor rooms are available.
One room can hold up to 10 guests.

## Discounts

- Digital Tourist Residency Card: 10% off the room rate. The card is free to issue.
- Jecheon Moa Card (local currency): local currency benefits apply at payment.

Call the front desk at +82-43-651-8000 before booking to ask how each discount applies.

## Facilities

- CAFE jc coffee shop — first floor, 06:00 to 24:00
- Business room — two work PCs and a printer in the first-floor lounge
- Meeting room — next to the main entrance on the first floor
- Laundry room — washer and dryer
- Private parking — free for guests
- Luggage storage — available, including after checkout
- Front desk open 24 hours

## In-room

- All rooms non-smoking
- Air sterilizer in every room
- OTT streaming
- Clothing steamer (selected room types)
- Massage chair (selected room types)
- Whirlpool bath (selected room types)
- Twin bed rooms available

## Guest information

- Extra bedding: KRW 20,000 per set, paid at the hotel
- Free to borrow at the front desk: hair iron, phone charger
- Available on request: disposable cutlery, first-aid supplies
- Lost property is held for up to four weeks
- Under Korean recycling law, single-use amenities are not provided free of charge.
  Toothpaste and toothbrushes are free.
- Day use: 3 hours, ending by 15:00 regardless of entry time

## Facilities NOT available (often listed incorrectly elsewhere)

The following are not operated. Older listings on booking sites may say otherwise.

- Sauna — none.
- Fitness centre — none.
- Valet parking — not offered. There is a free private car park; guests park themselves.
- In-room PC — not in standard rooms. Work PCs were moved to the first-floor lounge.
  The Deluxe 2PC room type does have PCs.

  - Naver Map: https://map.naver.com/p/search/%EC%A0%9C%EC%B2%9C%20JC%ED%98%B8%ED%85%94

- Booking is taken through Naver Booking, which is in Korean. Overseas guests may call +82-43-651-8000.
- Late arrivals are fine; the front desk is staffed 24 hours.
